While building Rocket Companies and investing billions in the Motor City’s development, he was a rare disease parent. Gilbert’s oldest child, Nick, died in 2023 following a lifelong battle with neurofibromatosis, a genetic disease. Famously, Nick was a good luck charm for the Cleveland Cavaliers. Since his death, the Gilbert family have pledged millions to fund research in the hopes of finding a cure for NF.
